comment: Lectures and material is clear, not too much work outside class. Her lectures are slow at times, but she's willing to help. No final exam, but final project that she gives lots of time for and makes it manageable to do well on. Overall exams are easy if you pay attention and she's a good choice for dsst 289.

Dr. G was solid. Her lectures are straight-forward but slow at times. Tests were reflective of class material and she was always available for help if needed. I'd definitely recommend her for DSST 289.

She tends to be pretty laid-back and her evaluations are always fair. There is a quick reading/homework before every class. There is a take home and written portion to all midterms. The take-home portion is harder but altogether, tests were fairly easy as long as you paid attention. Lectures are also kind of the same as the readings.
